newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKISH STOCK INDEX DOWN 3.7 PCT IN PROFIT-TAKING.
newsitem.headline: TURKISH STOCK INDEX DOWN 3.7 PCT IN PROFIT-TAKING.

text.p: The Turkish stock market index plunged 3.7 percent in major profit-taking on Thursday after a three-week non-stop rally.
The IMKB-100 index fell to 76,572.25, down 2,939.57 points from Wednesday. The gains had totalled 22.7 percent on Wednesday since September 13.
Daily trade volume rose to 18.6 trillion lira vs 16.0 trillion lira on Wednesday.
